summary.text: Son of Ophion at Peirithous' wedding — the first centaur to spoil the inner sanctuary, snatching a chandelier to strike Celadon the Lapith.

story.text: When cups and wine-casks became weapons, Amycus the Ophionid was first to plunder the shrine's gifts: he snatched a chandelier blazing with lamps, lifted it high as a bull-stunner, and smashed it against the Lapith Celadon's forehead. He is not Amycus king of the Bebryces, son of Poseidon, whom Pollux killed on the Argonaut voyage.
